test_augmentations_chain: test the AugmentationsTest class to verify chaining normalize, resize, and random_crop augmentations on a dataset
test_augmentations_normalize: test the normalize augmentation to confirm grayscale images are converted to RGB color space
test_augmentations_resize: test the resize augmentation to verify images are resized to the specified target dimensions
test_augmentations_central_crop_window: test the central_crop_window function to compute bounding box coordinates for a given image shape and padding
test_augmentations_random_sample_crop_wi: test the sample_random_crop_window function to verify it produces varied crop windows within area and aspect ratio bounds
